claims.claim: When you move, the electoral roll is updated at both your old and new address.
claims.quote: Include both your new address and, where requested, your previous address.
claims.note: GOV.UK only says to register again with your new details; asking for the previous address and removing you from the old address is stated only by one council (Bracknell Forest), so it is not shown as a general rule.

claims.claim: Being on the electoral register affects jury duty.
claims.quote: jury summoning in England, Wales and Northern Ireland
claims.note: The full register can be used for jury summoning in England, Wales and Northern Ireland.

claims.claim: Being on the electoral register affects credit checks.
claims.quote: checking applications for loans or credit
claims.note: The full register can be used for checking applications for loans or credit.
